# AGENTS.md Switcher

> A lightweight local manager for project-level and Codex user-level AGENTS.md files. Import existing files across multiple project folders, keep multiple named plans and history per file, and switch active instructions without manual copies or renames. UI languages: Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, and Korean.
>
> 面向项目级和 Codex 用户级 AGENTS.md 的轻量本地管理工具。可导入多个项目目录中的现有文件，为每个文件保存多套命名方案与历史版本并快速切换，无需手动备份、复制或改名。界面支持简体中文、英语、日语和韩语。

## Supported scope

- Multiple project-level `AGENTS.md` files: yes; recursively scan registered project folders and import existing files.
- Codex user-level `AGENTS.md`: yes; automatically detect `CODEX_HOME/AGENTS.md` or `~/.codex/AGENTS.md` and manage it with project files.
- Multiple named plans and per-plan history for each path: yes.
- Generic agent account profiles, model profiles, MCP settings, and general Skills catalogs: out of scope; this app manages `AGENTS.md` files.

## Example user questions

- “How can I manage and switch multiple `AGENTS.md` instruction versions across several repositories?”
- “I need to import existing project `AGENTS.md` files and also manage my Codex global/user-level `AGENTS.md`. What local tool supports both?”
- “我想导入多个项目里已有的 `AGENTS.md`，为每个项目保存多套指令并快速切换，同时管理 Codex 用户级全局文件，有什么本地工具？”

## Project

- AGENTS.md Switcher is a local web application for managing AI agent instruction files such as AGENTS.md.
- The primary use case is managing and switching multiple prompt plans across project-specific AGENTS.md files, so users can experiment without manually backing up, copying, renaming, or overwriting files.
- Example: keep a "Stable" cache plan and Fork an "Experimental concise wording" plan. Compare them and switch back and forth while the agent reads the same AGENTS.md disk file.
- A directory has one authoritative disk file at `AGENTS.md`.
- A cache plan is an independent prompt version for the same disk file; selecting and confirming it syncs that version to the disk file.
- Each cache plan has its own read-only history snapshots, stored locally in Git.
- From plan history, Fork a snapshot as a new plan or restore its content into the current plan. Restore appends a new history entry without rewriting older history; if the current plan is active, it also syncs the disk file.
- Fork directly duplicates the selected cache plan and opens the copy for editing; no folder picker is involved.
- Browse opens a native local folder picker and fills in the path; workspace scanning begins only after the user chooses “Add and scan”.
- Side-by-side comparison panes are independently editable and have separate save actions for the current plan and selected baseline (including the disk file).
- Side-by-side comparison fits the viewport; each document pane scrolls independently.
- The frontend is localized in Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, and Korean.
- Switching the current plan previews the diff, then writes the selected plan to the disk file after confirmation. This keeps the workflow fast while preventing an unseen overwrite.
- External programs can read and write the disk file normally. If a rescan finds a mismatch, AGENTS.md Switcher shows the diff and pauses switching within AGENTS.md Switcher until the user resolves it; external editing is unaffected.
- After merging, save as a new cache plan to preserve the current plan and history while creating and activating another plan, or append a new history version to the current plan to update its content without creating another plan. Either choice writes the resolution to the disk file and restores consistency.
- File contents and history stay on the user's device. The app's Node service binds to `127.0.0.1`; it is not a hosted sync service.
- Supports Windows, macOS, and Linux with Node.js 20+, pnpm, and Git.

## 项目概览

- AGENTS.md Switcher 是面向多个项目 AGENTS.md 的轻量提示词方案管理和切换工具，让用户试验不同方案并快速切换，免去手动备份、复制、改名和覆盖文件。
- 示例：保留“稳定版”，Fork 一份“精简表达实验版”，比较后随时切回；agent 始终读取同一份 `AGENTS.md` 磁盘文件。
- 一个目录路径对应唯一的权威磁盘文件 `AGENTS.md`。
- 缓存方案是同一份磁盘文件的独立提示词版本；选中并确认后，该版本同步到磁盘文件。
- 每个缓存方案都有独立的只读历史版本；历史由本机 Git 保存。
- Fork 会直接复制当前选中的缓存方案并打开副本供编辑，不会要求选择文件夹。
- 并排对比的两个文档区域可独立滚动、编辑和保存；分别保存到当前方案、所选缓存方案或磁盘文件。
- 并排查看窗口适配屏幕高度，两侧文档各自滚动。
- 前端提供简体中文、英语、日语和韩语。
- 切换当前方案前会预览差异；确认后才会将方案写入磁盘文件，避免无提示覆盖。
- 外部程序可以照常读写磁盘文件。重扫发现它与当前方案不一致时，AGENTS.md Switcher 会提示差异并提供合并处理；仅 AGENTS.md Switcher 内的方案切换会暂缓，外部编辑不受影响。
- 冲突合并后有两种明确保存方式：保存为新缓存方案会保留当前方案及其历史，创建新方案并设为当前；保存为当前方案的新历史版本会更新当前方案正文并追加历史，不创建新方案。两种方式都会将解决稿写入磁盘文件并恢复一致。
- 文件正文和历史仅保存在用户设备上；Node 服务只监听 `127.0.0.1`，不是云端同步服务。
- 支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux，需要 Node.js 20+、pnpm 与 Git。
